status: normative quotient for one terminal architecture view; not a completion claim

meta.purpose: Show ETHOS as a repository-native constitutional narrow waist: bounded intent and authority produce relation-aware cooperative or comparative Work Lanes; evidence governs admission, refresh, hold, or retirement; candidate and accepted refs advance through distinct exact-CAS boundaries; durable grounds preserve recovery, succession, and autonomous adoption.
meta.maturity_display: Terminal-design concepts must remain visually distinguishable from current implemented mechanisms.
meta.projection_rule: Every graph node and edge is either projected exactly once or omitted once with one explicit absence reason.

mandatory_topology: accepted repository reality is the dominant horizontal axis
Commitment and Attestation form the only durable ground lineage
authority is bounded and visibly terminates before fresh selection
candidate Work Lanes branch from one exact candidate base and remain isolated until proof
fresh recheck and exact Git CAS form one local effect joint
actor session host skill and native tool loss cannot break semantic or accepted-reality continuity
Brownfield and Greenfield are entry conditions; self-governance and autonomous peer adoption use the same kernel without privileged paths
publication remote is an outward effect target, never an autonomous adopter or truth owner
OpenSpec and Git are selected carriers; Skills and native tools are capabilities only

primitive_contract.law: Every rendered primitive has exactly one visual owner, one bounded purpose, explicit execution constraints, and no authority beyond its semantic or compositional role.

primitive_kinds.point: A localized state, judgment, proof, endpoint, or disposition mark; never an unexplained ornament.
primitive_kinds.line: A declared continuity, relation, boundary, flow, or guide; every interruption is semantic or forbidden.
primitive_kinds.surface: A field, seam, payload, or geometry boundary with explicit ownership and paint order.
primitive_kinds.text: Visible language sourced only from the canonical copy deck and placed by declared projection geometry.
primitive_kinds.machine: Non-authoring geometry retained solely for deterministic validation and projection traceability.
primitive_kinds.definition: A shared paint or marker definition that creates no independent visible meaning.

canvas_field.purpose: Provide a quiet, printable field and subordinate material texture.

visible_copy.purpose: Name and qualify the architecture in one controlled reading hierarchy.

composition_guides.purpose: Organize strata and bind local repository realities without asserting authority.

authority_boundary.purpose: Show bounded authorization, its exact termination, and explicit successor selection.

durable_grounds.purpose: Show Commitment and Attestation as durable grounds across effect and succession.

transaction_flow.purpose: Carry candidate and accepted-state transitions through the two independent exact-effect boundaries.
constraints: candidate CAS distinct from accepted-root CAS

intent_and_state.purpose: Render deterministic intent compilation and explicit repository states.
constraints: state remains discrete on a continuous lineage

replaceable_capability.purpose: Supply replaceable agent, skill, session, host, and native-tool capability.

recovery.purpose: Return loss or unknown outcome to observation and recompilation.
constraints: never crosses directly into accepted reality

lane_isolation.purpose: Show isolated worktrees, bounded ownership, prewrite, cooperation, competition, and narrow serialization.
constraints: one worktree lease and prewrite per lane

lane_proof.purpose: Bind proof locally to each lane before comparison or disposition.

lane_disposition.purpose: Distinguish admission, continuation, hold, non-selection, and proved retirement.

proof_field.purpose: Bind exact claims, scope, and verifier evidence before admission.

admission_gate.purpose: Separate evaluation from the only runner permitted to approach a CAS boundary.
constraints: BLOCK and UNKNOWN produce no effect

exact_cas.purpose: Mark the narrow linearization point where one exact compare-and-swap may change state.
constraints: accepted and candidate CAS remain distinct

repository_locality.purpose: Keep authority, judgment, observation, and exact effects local to each repository or remote target.

scenario_origin.purpose: Differentiate Brownfield, Greenfield, self-model repair, and adopter claim intake without changing the kernel.

shared_grammar.purpose: Show the current OpenSpec plus Git binding and replaceable outward projections as carriers, not essence.

geometry_owner.purpose: Provide exact invisible owner bounds for layout, routing, and collision verification.

semantic_witness.purpose: Carry semantic graph identities into the artifact for deterministic projection audits.
constraints: never becomes a second human-facing diagram

shared_definition.purpose: Define shared gradients, filters, and arrowheads once without adding independent marks.

rules: The SVG root binds the exact semantic graph and view profile SHA-256 digests.

Every declared node projection has visible, unexempt semantic witnesses with exact graph, view, maturity and instance identities; edge machine carriers may be non-painted only when explicitly admitted below and backed by visible human structure.
A repeated node projection has at least two visible SVG instances; direct and contained node projections have exactly one.
Every declared view edge has exactly one exact machine carrier; its human-visible expression remains in the structural layer.
A view-edge witness carries the complete space-separated set of graph edge identities and relation kinds collapsed into it.
A collapsed view edge is legal only when all source graph nodes map to one view source and all target graph nodes map to one view target.
A visible semantic SVG node or edge not declared by this profile is forbidden.
No semantic node witness may be hidden; only the explicitly admitted edge machine-carrier role may be non-painted, and the geometry gate forbids any residual witness ink.
SVG metadata, title, desc, labels and hidden text obey the same language contract.
